📺 Workin’ Moms (2017–2023)

Workin’ Moms follows four women navigating the hilarious and emotional challenges of balancing motherhood, careers, relationships, and personal ambitions in Toronto, Canada. At the center of the story is Kate Foster, a determined public relations executive struggling to manage her demanding career while raising her young son. Alongside her friends Anne, Frankie, and Jenny, Kate faces everything from workplace pressures and parenting disasters to complicated marriages, unexpected friendships, and difficult personal decisions. As the women support one another through life’s unpredictable moments, they discover that being a mother doesn’t mean giving up their individual dreams. Combining sharp humor, relatable situations, and heartfelt storytelling, Workin’ Moms explores friendship, family, identity, love, and the everyday realities of modern motherhood.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Catherine Reitman

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.
